name: Pesto Pasta
steps: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente.
Blend basil, garlic, pine nuts and olive oil into a smooth paste.
Drain pasta, reserving ¼ cup of pasta water.
Mix pasta with pesto, adding pasta water as needed. Serve immediately.

name: Spanish Omelette
steps: Peel and thinly slice potatoes and onion.
Fry in olive oil over medium heat until soft, about 15 min. Drain excess oil.
Beat 5 eggs with salt, add potatoes and onion, and mix well.
Cook in a lightly oiled pan over low heat. Flip carefully and cook the other side.
Serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Lentil Soup
steps: Rinse lentils thoroughly.
Sauté diced onion, garlic and carrot in olive oil until soft.
Add chopped tomato and cook 2 minutes.
Add lentils, cover with water or broth, season with cumin and salt.
Simmer 30 minutes until lentils are tender. Adjust seasoning.

name: Shakshuka
steps: Sauté diced onion, garlic and bell pepper in olive oil until soft.
Add cumin and paprika, cook 1 minute.
Pour in tomato sauce and simmer 10 minutes.
Make wells in the sauce and crack eggs in. Cover and cook 5–8 min until eggs are set.

name: Chicken Curry
steps: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Sauté onion in oil until golden. Add garlic and ginger, cook 1 min.
Add spices and toast briefly. Add chicken and brown on all sides.
Pour in tomato sauce and coconut milk. Simmer 20 minutes.
Serve over rice with fresh cilantro.

name: Margherita Pizza
steps: Mix flour, yeast, salt and water. Knead until smooth and let rise 1 hour.
Roll out dough into a thin round.
Spread tomato sauce and add sliced mozzarella.
Bake at 250°C (480°F) for 10–12 minutes.
Top with fresh basil and a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Homemade Hummus
steps: Drain and rinse chickpeas (reserve a few for topping).
Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic and salt until smooth.
Add a little water to reach desired consistency.
Top with olive oil, paprika and reserved chickpeas.

name: Rice Pudding
steps: Bring milk to a near boil with lemon peel and a cinnamon stick.
Add rice and sugar. Stir constantly over low heat for 30 minutes.
Rice should be tender and mixture thick and creamy.
Remove lemon peel. Serve warm or chilled, dusted with ground cinnamon.

name: Guacamole
steps: Halve and mash ripe avocados in a bowl.
Add lime juice, finely diced onion, cilantro and optional jalapeño.
Fold in diced tomato. Season with salt.
Serve immediately with tortilla chips.

name: Classic Beef Burger
steps: Season ground beef with salt and pepper. Form into patties.
Cook on a hot grill or pan 3–4 min per side.
Add cheese in the last minute to melt.
Toast the bun. Assemble with lettuce, tomato and onion.

name: Caprese Salad
steps: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella into even rounds.
Alternate layers of tomato and mozzarella on a plate.
Tuck fresh basil leaves between slices.
Drizzle with olive oil. Season with salt and black pepper.

name: Veggie Stir Fry
steps: Chop all vegetables into similar-sized pieces.
Heat a wok or large pan over high heat with oil.
Stir fry starting with harder vegetables (carrots, broccoli), then softer ones.
Add garlic, ginger, soy sauce and sesame oil. Toss and serve over rice.

name: Lemon Garlic Salmon
steps: Season salmon fillets with salt and lemon zest.
Heat olive oil and butter in a pan over medium-high heat.
Cook salmon 4 min per side until golden.
Add garlic for the last minute. Squeeze lemon juice and top with parsley.

name: Banana Oat Pancakes
steps: Mash ripe bananas. Beat in eggs and milk.
Stir in oats, baking powder and salt. Let rest 5 min.
Cook spoonfuls on a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Flip when bubbles form (about 2 min). Serve with honey or fresh fruit.

name: Black Bean Tacos
steps: Season drained black beans with cumin, garlic powder and salt.
Warm beans in a pan with a little oil for 5 minutes.
Warm corn tortillas on a dry pan.
Fill tortillas with beans, sliced avocado, lime juice and cilantro.

name: Gazpacho
steps: Roughly chop all vegetables.
Soak bread in water 5 minutes, then squeeze dry.
Blend all ingredients until very smooth.
Season with vinegar, salt and olive oil. Chill at least 1 hour before serving.

name: Pad Thai
steps: Soak rice noodles in warm water until pliable, then drain.
Stir fry garlic and shrimp in a hot wok.
Push to side, scramble eggs in the center.
Add noodles and sauce (soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar). Toss together.
Add bean sprouts and green onion. Serve with lime and crushed peanuts.

name: Chocolate Lava Cake
steps: Melt dark chocolate and butter together. Let cool slightly.
Whisk eggs and sugar until pale. Fold in chocolate mixture.
Add flour and salt. Divide into greased ramekins.
Bake at 200°C (390°F) for 10–12 minutes. Center should remain soft.
Invert onto a plate and serve immediately with vanilla ice cream.
